{{Quote|At the Theed Coliseum, you can try Gungan Sling Painting. There, you will help Gungans paint dancing droids!|[[King/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]|<ref name="ELAC" />}}
The '''Theed Coliseum''' was a large amphitheatre designed for sporting events and entertainment. It was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Coliseum hosted a demonstration of [[Gungan sling painting]] as part of the festivities surrounding the victory over the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invading]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|army]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|We hope you're enjoying your stay at the Theed Coliseum!|The slingshot announcer|<ref name="ELAC" />}}
[[File:Amidala_on_the_Coliseum_plaza.png|thumb|left|150px|Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] in front of the Coliseum in 32 BBY]]
An gigantic open-air venue, the Coliseum was a funnel-shaped building that hosted contests and spectacles in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It consisted of seating tiers that surrounded a central performance area. Private covered boxes were also provided, presumably for upper-class citizens. At the top of the building, a gallery featured statues of honored [[Naboo philosophers]]<ref name="ELAC" /> similar to those who stood on the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|forecourt]] of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Its facade was also decorated with banners and garlands of flowers.<ref name="ELAC" />

The Coliseum rose from [[Theed Coliseum Plaza|its own plaza]], in the vicinity of a large waterfall, and was very close to other local entertainment buildings, namely the [[Theed Music Hall]] and the [[Naboo Puppet Theater]]. Visitors standing at the foot of the Coliseum could spot the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo's]] dome-roofed [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|palace]] in the distance.<ref name="ELAC" />

==History==
{{Quote|It's a lovely day here in Theed. The weather is perfect for... Droid Painting!|The slingshot announcer|<ref name="ELAC" />}}
[[File:Theed_Coliseum_tiers.png|thumb|150px|A sling painting performance at the Coliseum]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of Naboo and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] joined their forces to fight off the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|armies]], who had [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The coalition led to victory, and the two peoples became officially unified during a huge celebration in Theed.<ref name="TPM" /> Among other revelries, a Gungan "[[Gungan sling painting|sling painting]]" demonstration was held in the Coliseum, with a [[Gungan Sling Brigade|quartet]] of Gungan warriors trying to paint dancing [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] before a delighted hometown crowd.<ref name="ELAC" />
